title: StrategySpec
description: The versioned StrategySpec contract (D-06, FOUND-04). Bounded to exactly what the D-26 SMA crossover strategy needs -- Phase 1 proves the seam, not the expressiveness. Neither this schema's generated Pydantic model nor its generated TypeScript type is authoritative; this file is.

spec_version.description: Contract version. The only permitted value for this schema is "1".

indicators.description: The two SMA windows the crossover compares. Both are declared as positive integers only -- fast_period < slow_period is a semantic rule enforced by engine.dsl.spec.load_spec, not a schema constraint. Draft 2020-12 has no portable keyword comparing one property's value against another's, so this schema deliberately does not attempt to express that ordering.

fast_period.description: Fast SMA window length, in bars.

slow_period.description: Slow SMA window length, in bars.

entry.description: The single permitted entry rule: go long when the fast SMA crosses above the slow SMA.

exit.description: The single permitted exit rule: flatten when the fast SMA crosses back below the slow SMA.

sizing.description: Position sizing for the single permitted entry.

trade_size.description: Money-shaped field (D-07): a decimal string, never a JSON number, so this generates a TypeScript string and never a float-carrying number. Maximum scale is 8 decimal places.
